reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread reply on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

Priyanka posted in that channel on 2025-09-03 that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, once Southgate had cleared its backlog.

The channel only calls the depot "Southgate" and gives no street address. I couldn't find a Tansley account folder in the shared files, so I told him I don't have more site detail than that name. I checked that he's a member of the channel before reading it, and I didn't use the gbrain knowledge base or message search, because both can return conversations he can't see.
